concerns.text: The plan validates the mediation effect and the predictive gain of residual‑stress features using a *synthetic* dataset that is generated from the same empirical relationships (process → residual stress → fatigue life) described in the literature. Because the data‑generation model embeds the very causal pathway being tested, the validation targets (indirect effect size, improvement in MAPE) are not independent of the predictors. This creates a circular/tautological confirmation: the analysis will inevitably recover the built‑in effect, so the claimed scientific conclusions cannot be demonstrated on real, independent data.
